outcome.technical: Applied refs/audit/kept/P142.31-6yq (git diff <parent> kept | git apply -3, exit 0; index reset for the four files). drive-phase.py: ONE predicate before anything comes down, tree_undescribed(tree, records, work), asked by recut_tree right after the base check and before carry_beside_work/recut_conflicts/keep_redo_work/drop_tree; any answer but [] refuses ('redo refused: the tree of <id> holds what a recut cannot carry ... nothing was recut'). It asks two things, off git's records and the disk, never off a listing an ignore setting can narrow: (a) anything a commit cannot carry - mode 160000 in the tree's own index (ls-files -s), at HEAD or in the work commit (ls-tree -r --full-tree), or a .git anywhere below the tree's top (_nested_repositories, os.walk, links not followed, onerror makes an unread directory a could-not-read, not a pass); (b) a staged state the work does not hold - paths in diff-index --cached HEAD AND diff-index --cached <work> (both --ita-invisible-in-index --ignore-submodules=none), records left out. That replaces the work['links']/_links_touched check (removed; tree_work no longer returns 'links'). The read of the work (carry_commit): _index_flags reads ls-files -v; the seed copies entries and the skip-worktree flag of entries whose file is absent (so it is not read as a deletion); assume-unchanged and present skip-worktree files are read from disk, and every flagged path joins the status-listed paths the check compares; _unheld uses ls-files -o --exclude-standard (an ignored file the scratch index lacks is held) and diff --ignore-submodules=none; tree_changed's status and every diff in the read use --ignore-submodules=none. Paths keep their bytes: _git_path (os.fsdecode, surrogateescape fallback) in tree_changed, _unheld, _changed_between, _index_flags, tree_undescribed, redo_held's unmerged list and tree_holds_only_integrated; _shown renders them for messages. redo_left's could-not-read fallback no longer gives the 'diff against the pin printing nothing' rule (wrong for a path the head moved); it says a moved path reads merged and prescribes the apply only where the tree lacks the work. Docstrings of _seed_from_index, carry_commit, tree_work, recut_tree rewritten to say only what the code does. tools/lints/_deps.py: GIT_PATH_BASE_EXEMPT rows for _index_flags and tree_undescribed, _unheld's reason widened (git_path_base_violations() == []; tests/test__deps.py 254/254). PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md 'A wave's edges' paragraph rewritten for the predicate, with case ids. Tests (ar-block, tests/test_drive_phase.py): 15 new cases - ar17c ar18 ar18b ar18c ar18d ar18e ar18f ar19 ar20 ar20b ar20c ar20d ar21 ar22 ar6f; ar-block 40/40 exit 0 (was 25/25). Gate: python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_drive_phase.py exit 0, '1/1 files ok, 628 cases' [1541.6s, 116 blocks]. ruff, vermin -t=3.8-, house_style_violations, prose_number_claims, doc_prose_numbers, guide_enumeration all clean on the four files. Decisions: the index is part of the work, and a commit can hold one state per path, so a staged state the files do not show REFUSES (ar20 rm --cached of a tracked unignored file; ar20b MM put back; an unmerged entry refuses the same way) - this also refuses 'git add, then edit further' (index differs from base and from the files); the refusal says to settle it in the tree and answer again. An ignored file the task untracked is carried as the deletion it is (ar19). Any gitlink refuses even an untouched, never-checked-out submodule (ar18f), as the brief's invariant says. Review probes: copies retargeted at this tree in <scratchpad>/P142.40-probe/adv and /b (the ones calling the removed _links_touched or work['links'] now print tree_undescribed); run before (before-*.log) and after (after-*.log), all exit 0: ignore=all/diff.ignoreSubmodules=all pointer moves now read 'sub is a link to a nested repository'; ignore=dirty/all dirty submodules are refused by the read itself; rm_cached_ignored and rm_cached_ignored_dir now carry (was refused forever); rm_cached_not_ignored, staged_then_reverted, unmerged refuse in tree_undescribed; skip_worktree_absent no longer carries a deletion; probe3 shows the predicate refusing before the remove that deletes the modules dir. Mutation probe: python3 <scratchpad>/P142.40-probe/mutations.py <home>/dev/audit-plugin/claude-plugins-P142.40-6yq <scratchpad>/P142.40-probe/work --jobs 7 ; 19 rows, each in its own copy, anchors asserted once and read back, __pycache__ purged; final run '19 rows run, 0 survived, every anchor landed' (mutations-final.log). Over-fire rows: every entry read as a link -> ar2 ar18e ar19 ar20c ar21; walk counts a .git-prefixed name -> ar18e; walk counts the tree's own .git -> ar2 ...; every staged path refused -> ar15 ar19 ar20c; records not left out of the staged check -> ar20d; ignored unheld again -> ar19; records checked in the read -> ar4. The first run had three survivors and each was acted on: ar18b is refused by two layers (the read and the predicate), so it left the predicate row's want list; ar17 is now refused by the index check, not the read (an ignored forced file the read misses is held on the files' side by design), so it moved rows; the record exclusion in the staged check had no case, so ar20d was added. Dependants: tests/test_drive_phase.py changed as above; PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md changed as above; tools/affected.py, README.md, docs/research/pipeline-cost-design.md, hooks/detect-plan-skip.py, record-risk-confirmation.py, stamp-verification.py still correct - git grep finds none naming tree_work, carry_commit, tree_changed, _unheld, _seed_from_index, redo_left, _links_touched, _changed_between or tree_holds_only_integrated; _changed_between (tools/lints/_deps.py row) now passes --ignore-submodules=none and keeps path bytes, and its row's reason is still true; _carries, _clip, _mark unchanged. tests/test_drive_phase.py's dependants: .github/sweep-costs.json's per-file cost is now low for a larger ar-block, and the sweep still passed within its per-block timeout; _counting, _follower_cases, _head and the STAGES table are unchanged; tools/lints/_deps.py's dependants read GIT_PATH_BASE_EXEMPT, to which two rows were added. Left, not fixed (out of scope; for the plan's Faults): tree_holds_only_integrated (retire_member's task-remove --force) reads git status without --ignore-submodules=none and compares files by open(), so a submodule commit or a nested repository in a closed member's tree reads as held and is deleted on retire - the same class this task closed for the recut. layer_violations reports panel/_panel_state.py, not a file of this task.
outcome.descriptive: A redo now takes a task's tree down only when the work commit and the tree's own index describe it whole: any submodule link, nested repository or staged-only state refuses by name first, and an ignored file the task untracked no longer blocks it.
